Exclude this standalone employer-financing package. Sections 15600-15611 allocate and collect DIR fund assessments and fraud surcharges using insurance premiums, payroll and self-insured indemnity; section 15607 addresses separate policy charges, adjustments and refunds. They finance the compensation/enforcement system rather than determine safe residential work, contractor coverage requirements or liability for an injury during that work. Exclude the MTUS clinical-guideline update. The four changed sections incorporate ACOEM shoulder, elbow, hand/wrist/forearm (July 14, 2025) and traumatic-brain-injury (October 7, 2025) treatment guidelines. Their function is the medical treatment standard within workers compensation, not worksite prevention, contractor coverage or responsibility for an injury. Direct employment of maintenance staff does not bring this clinical treatment subsystem within the residential workflow aperture.

Exclude the medical utilization-review administration package. The final OAL approval identifies treating-physician reporting and change procedures, independent medical review, investigations and penalties for UR/IMR violations. These administer treatment authorization and medical-review compliance after a compensation claim; they do not determine the safety of residential work, contractor insurance coverage or underlying injury liability. The dependent 2026 forms correction, IMR application and UR-plan application share that excluded function.
